scope: One 50-step complete image-to-Gaussian-point-cloud run on one development photograph, original gated image encoders, staged models and graphics-device decoder. The executable imported its Python dependencies before timing began. This is a single measurement, not a latency distribution or a real-time claim.
precision: Original runtime denoiser and octree; weighted covariance mixed two-/four-bit Gaussian matrices; other components preserved.
environment: Windows; NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090; PyTorch 2.10.0+cu128; local incompatible xFormers disabled.
limits: PyTorch memory counters do not measure total system graphics memory or host memory. One photo and one seed do not establish general fidelity; this does not compare with ground-truth 3D.
